comparison.objective: Mount a spring-loaded rack rail between two posts at a marked rack position; unlike damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual spring compression, end alignment, and retained mounting versus recessed tool use, collar adjustment, and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Title gives target position and between-post mounting; body, seating/retention tolerances, pinch/damage rules, and all specs are missing.
comparison.reason: It tests spring-loaded structural installation, not tuning and relocking an adjustable shock absorber.
